Somewhere beyond the horizon, someone was already home, and that was enough.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，呼吸绵长而沉稳。路灯仍亮着，橙黄色的光洒在空无一人的街道上，像一层薄薄的蜜。远处传来环卫工人扫帚划过柏油路面的沙沙声，节奏单调却令人安心。早点铺的灯率先亮起，蒸笼里白雾升腾，裹着面粉与葱花的气息飘向还带着凉意的空气中。一只流浪猫从巷口闪过，消失在黑暗里。天际线最东边，一抹灰蓝正悄悄替换夜色，城市即将醒来，但此刻，它只属于那些默默守夜的人。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a thing solves a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive task needs a stopping point (called a base case) so it doesn't go on forever — like finally finding a word you already understand.\n• So a recursive function calls itself with a simpler input each time until it hits that stopping point, then passes all the answers back up the chain."}
